paragraphs.en: 本文提出了一种优化文本到图像生成器以生成适合视频生成的“黄金锚点”的方法，显著提升了视频的质量。 Video generation supports digital content creation, with applications in virtual avatars, AI-driven filmmaking, interactive game engines, and world models. State-of-the-art systems achieve controllability primarily through image-to-video (I2V) generation, in which an injected anchor image determines the identity, composition, and style of the resulting video. In modern pipelines, this anchor is synthesized by a text-to-image (T2I) generator. This raises a largely overlooked question: Are images obtained directly from the T2I model truly suitable for current video models? Our analysis shows that anchor aesthetic and quality scores are weakly correlated with downstream video quality. The structure-and-texture score is negatively correlated with I2V video quality in both the visual and motion dimensions. Fine-tuning the T2I model on an image reward accordingly yields anchors with visibly denser structural and character detail: they score higher on image metrics, yet lower the video reward on every I2V model we test and change downstream motion unpredictably. We therefore introduce Golden Anchor Learning (GAL), to our knowledge the first framework for learning golden anchors by optimizing a T2I generator with downstream video feedback. GAL evaluates candidate anchors through the videos they induce under a frozen I2V model and converts video rewards into image-level preferences for DPO fine-tuning of the T2I generator. On all four I2V models, GAL raises the VBench average by $2.97\%$--$8.46\%$ over the untuned generator. The rendered clips also score higher under VideoReward-Overall, and their extracted frames under HPSv3 and UniPercept. GAL yields consistent motion gains across all four I2V models, as measured by a $5.62\%$--$38.24\%$ increase in VBench dynamic degree. Although GAL is trained only on HunyuanVideo-1.5 renders, these gains extend to the other three I2V models.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种优化文本到图像生成器以生成适合视频生成的“黄金锚点”的方法，显著提升了视频的质量。视频生成支持数字内容创作，应用于虚拟化身、AI驱动的电影制作、交互式游戏引擎和世界模型。 当前最先进的系统主要通过图像到视频（I2V）生成实现可控性，其中注入的锚点图像决定了最终视频的识别特征、构图和风格。 在现代流程中，该锚点由文本到图像（T2I）生成器合成。 这引出了一个长期被忽视的问题：直接从T2I模型获取的图像是否真的适合当前的视频模型？ 我们的分析表明，锚点的美学和质量得分与下游视频质量的相关性较弱。 结构-纹理得分在视觉和运动两个维度上均与I2V视频质量呈负相关。 因此，在图像奖励数据集上对T2I模型进行微调，可生成结构细节和角色细节明显更丰富的锚点：它们在图像指标上的得分更高，但在我们测试的所有I2V模型中，其视频奖励得分更低，且下游运动表现不可预测。 因此，我们提出了“黄金锚点学习”（Golden Anchor Learning, GAL），据我们所知，这是首个通过优化T2I生成器并引入下游视频反馈来学习黄金锚点的框架。 GAL通过候选锚点在固定I2V模型下生成的视频进行评估，并将视频奖励转化为图像层面的偏好，用于对T2I生成器进行DPO微调。 在所有四个I2V模型上，GAL相较于未经微调的生成器，将VBench平均得分提升了$2.97\%$--$8.46\%$。 渲染后的片段在VideoReward-Overall指标下的得分更高，其在HPSv3和UniPercept下提取的帧也表现更优。 GAL在所有四个I2V模型上均实现了稳定的运动质量提升，VBench动态度数的提升幅度为$5.62\%$--$38.24\%$。 尽管GAL仅在HunyuanVideo-1.5的渲染结果上进行训练，但这些改进也延伸到了其他三个I2V模型。
